meaning.long_meaning: Antaryami corresponds to the Sanskrit form अन्तर्यामिन्. Its core lexical sense is inner ruler, inner controller. अन्तर्यामिन् (antaryāmin) means the inner ruler or inner controller; a name of Vishnu.

faq.a: Antaryami is associated with Sanskrit. अन्तर्यामिन् (antaryāmin) means the inner ruler or inner controller; a name of Vishnu.
Yes — the underlying form अन्तर्यामिन् is Sanskrit.
Antaryami is used in Hindu naming practice, but Sanskrit origin alone does not make a name Hindu. The classification here rests on documented naming usage.
